mcq.q: Who won the women's singles title at the 22nd Commonwealth Table Tennis Championship 2026?
mcq.why: Yashaswini Ghorpade won; Sreeja Akula was runner-up.

mcq.q: Where was the 22nd Commonwealth Table Tennis Championship 2026 held?
mcq.why: It took place at Thyagraj Stadium, New Delhi, from July 27 to August 2, 2026.
